response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT t.* FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > o.avg_pulse_rate), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - o.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - s.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_above_second_average FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > s.avg_pulse_rate;
